manual.caution:
11. Cautions

  • Request publishing cannot be undone. Published manuscripts become the baseline of all later consistency analyses
  • While an AI call is running (manuscript generation, analysis, etc.), double-clicking its button does not run it again
  • Data is stored in the data/studio.db file. Deleting it removes all novels, manuscripts, and settings, so be careful
manual.flow:
3. Basic Workflow

Pick or create a novel on the main screen → discuss and organize ideas → hand off to design → flesh out the tree → start and revise writing → request review → analyze consistency → request publishing → next episode → …
  1. On the main screen, pick a novel or create one with a new title. Creating one takes you straight to the Ideas screen. The ← Novel List button at the top returns to the main screen at any time.
  2. Develop the material with AI, pressing the suggestion buttons on its answers to confirm the full synopsis and setting entries. Decide Part/Chapter usage and the total episode count.
  3. Press Finish ideas → to Story Design to hand off. Ideas become read-only after handoff.
  4. Flesh out the tree in Story Design. Once an episode's material is ready, you can start writing it right away.
  5. On the Writing screen, create an AI draft with Start writing, revise it yourself, then press Request review.
  6. In Author Review, analyze consistency and press Request publishing if all is well. If fixes are needed, use Back to writing to revise on the Writing screen.
  7. Repeat for the next episode. Check the Settings screen whenever you need to recall a setting.

manual.layout:
2. Screen Layout

Top bar

ElementMeaning
Novel pillShows only the current novel title. Click to open the novel info editor. The General tab edits the title and target length per episode; the Writing Style tab selects a system style and saves, edits, deletes, or applies your own styles
← Novel ListBack to the main (novel list) screen. The first screen is always the main screen
Model chipStatus dot + model and mode in use. Click to open the model switcher (pick one of the 2 models; restarts restore the .env value)
Token chipTokens used today / daily budget (remaining). Click to see this novel's AI call log (when, which role, how much, tokens, input/output prompts)

Main · Novel List

Novel cards show the work stage, finished episode count, and last-modified date. Title search and recently-modified ordering are supported. Continue jumps to the last stage you worked on, and Delete requires typing the same title for permanent deletion (AI usage history is kept). Each novel has its own address (#/novels/{uid}/…), so a link opens it directly. On first run, author registration (ID, pen name, password) comes first, and novels are visible only to the registered author.

Six tabs

TabWhat you do
1. IdeasDiscuss material with AI, organize the full synopsis and setting entries, then hand off to design once the spine is set
2. Story DesignFlesh out the Part → chapter → episode → scene tree, collaborating with the design partner
3. WritingWrite and revise the manuscript (the only editing path), then request a review
4. Author ReviewRead and compare the manuscript, analyze consistency, tidy the issue list and memory, then request publishing or return to writing
5. PublishingNovel publishing info, platforms, covers, and read-only final per-episode editions
6. SettingsSearch settings such as characters and places, and view change history
manual.start:
1. Getting Started

Just start one server. It serves the API and the UI from the same address, so no separate web server is needed.

cd server
..\.venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000

Open http://127.0.0.1:8000/ in your browser. The following are required.

  • Enter MODEL_API_KEY in the .env file (the server refuses to boot without it)
  • A green status dot on the top-bar model chip means the connection is fine
manual.states:
10. States and Terms

StateMeaning
Not startedNot yet written (outline only)
Writing WRITINGManuscript being written/revised on the Writing screen
In Review IN_REVIEWConsistency analysis, publish request, or return decision on the Author Review screen
Publishing PUBLISHINGPublish requested. Manuscript confirmed, read-only
Needs attentionError indicator. Check the reason in the Writing screen details
  • Auto retry: on manuscript validation failures such as short length, points out what is lacking and rewrites up to 3 times within the same request
  • Token budget: daily usage cap (default 1M). When exhausted, the episode gets a needs-attention mark
  • Manuscript rev: the management number of a manuscript version
manual.tab1:
4. Tab 1 — Ideas

Idea chat

  • Type freely or press the choices the AI offers to continue the conversation. Create separate chats per topic. The AI always offers concrete choices instead of open questions
  • Writing @setting-title or @node-ID in a message sends the full text of that material to the AI together with your message
  • Include chats in message picks how messages are included. Include all and Include none check or uncheck every message at once, while Select starts with only the latest chat checked so you can pick freely with the checkbox in front of each message
  • Use the checkboxes in front of the synopsis and settings to pick which material the AI receives. Checked entries are included even without @mentions. By default only the synopsis is checked, and the defaults reset when entering the screen and when an AI answer arrives

AI answers and suggestion buttons

An AI answer is split into a message to the author and organizing suggestion buttons. Pressing a setting-candidate button adds it to the setting entries at once, and pressing a synopsis-change button updates the full synopsis at once. Already-applied suggestions show as "applied". When a setting with the same title exists but the content differs, the button becomes an "apply edit to 'title'" button that rewrites the existing entry. Suggestion buttons apply immediately without calling the AI, and hovering shows what will be applied in a tooltip. The choice buttons below the chat, in contrast, continue the conversation — pressing one asks the AI again with that content.

Full synopsis

Shows the story flow of the whole novel, view only. It cannot be edited directly and changes only through the apply synopsis change button in AI answers.

Novel structure

Right below the synopsis, set the structure level (use Parts, Chapters only, or neither), the total episode count, the Part count, and a rough summary of each Part. Picking Part usage automatically turns Chapters on as well. Pressing the Novel structure button in the title row collapses the card into a one-line summary like 'Uses Parts, 200 episodes'. It must be confirmed together with the synopsis before handoff and is always included in AI chats (can be unchecked). Structures the AI suggests are applied with the apply to structure button in its answer (the button summarizes the included entries; hover for a detailed preview). If a Part list exists, Part usage turns on automatically with it. Handoff uses this card's saved values as-is.

Setting entries

  • Shows characters, worldviews, events, Part stories, and more, entry by entry. They are filled only through AI suggestion buttons; there is no manual add form. Each entry carries a unique-number (D001–) chip and a category chip
  • The one-line / flowing / full switch at the right of the title row picks the display style and the choice is kept. One-line shows number, category, title, and summary in one line (overflowing with …), flowing expands the full content, and full adds edit and delete buttons
  • Per-entry editing and deletion are supported (no undo; deleted D numbers are not reused). Chat inclusion is set with the checkbox in front of each entry
  • Export at the far right of the tab row downloads the full synopsis and setting entries as a Markdown file

Hand off to design

Just press Finish ideas → to Story Design. The AI plans the handoff, previews the design tree to be created (all Part, Chapter, and Episode entries) in a confirmation dialog, and creates it as-is on confirm. Episodes the AI could not fill in show as empty episodes to continue in design. The full synopsis text and setting entries are stored together in the top 'novel' node of the design so they can be seen on the design screen. The Ideas screen becomes read-only after handoff.
manual.tab1b:
5. Tab 2 — Story Design

Novel structure (left)

  • A hierarchy of novel → Part → chapter → episode → scene. Each entry has a P/C/E/S + 3-digit code (such as E001) inside the tree, and the full code combined with the tree number (such as N002-E001) is unique across the novel
  • Adding, searching, and archiving are supported. Levels you chose not to use at handoff (Part/Chapter) are disabled in the add list
  • Designs made the older way can be moved into a tree with Create episodes from existing outline

Design editor (center)

View and edit the selected entry's logline, details (JSON), and child logline list. On an Episode entry, Write this episode → jumps straight to the Writing screen. Episode writing can start before the whole design is finished.

Design partner (right)

  • Chat with AI about the selected entry and review change proposals. Proposals take effect only when applied
  • Child design (Expand): select a Chapter and design episode loglines in bulk, then apply them individually or all at once
manual.tab2:
6. Tab 3 — Writing

Loading a design ID

When you enter, the current novel's latest design loads automatically. To see another design, enter its design ID and press Load. Coming via "Write this episode" from Story Design selects that design and episode automatically.

Reading the episode table

  • Status: one of Not started, Writing, In Review, or Publishing. When a Needs attention chip is attached, check the reason
  • Clicking an episode row: shows the manuscript in the center and expands the design logline and scenes below the row. Pressing an expanded row again collapses it
  • Details: shows that episode's manuscript in the center
  • Row buttons: Start writing when not started, Request review when writing, otherwise go to review
  • Order: writing can only start from episode 1 in order. Until the previous episode is published, the next episode's Start writing stays disabled

Writing flow

  • Pressing Start writing creates an AI draft and the episode becomes Writing
  • To rewrite from scratch while writing, press Rewrite with AI. An unsaved working draft is kept as a pre-regeneration draft version
  • To fix only part of it, instruct the AI chat edits panel below. Select lines in the manuscript, then press Include selected lines in chat to insert line numbers like @L12. Sending saves a new version and keeps the Writing state
  • After revising the manuscript yourself, pressing Request review moves it to In Review. If the working draft differs from the latest version, a submission snapshot version is created automatically so the review and publishing targets match
  • Episodes returned from review show the return reason at the top. Revise and request review again
  • Manuscripts of In Review and Publishing episodes are read-only on this screen

Details · Center manuscript

  • The working draft is the manuscript being revised and is auto-saved, while Save version leaves an unchangeable snapshot. The version list is newest-first; past versions are read-only, and Restore this version makes a new-version copy of one
  • Turning on Highlight changes vs previous version shows added (green) and edited (yellow) lines plus an expander for deleted sentences. The selected version is compared against its chronologically previous version
  • Body search finds the literal string case-insensitively and steps through previous/next matches. Search highlights show together with change highlights
  • Fix the draft with Edit directly, and open a read-only preview with Fullscreen. Reading settings (font, size, line height, letter spacing, width) are stored in the browser and kept across episodes
  • Pressing the copy icon at the right of Fullscreen copies the body currently shown to the clipboard
  • On save conflicts or network failures, your input is kept and recovery guidance appears. Compare with Check latest manuscript, then save your input or use the server copy
  • Clear manuscript clears only the draft after confirmation (saved versions kept). Manuscripts of published episodes are locked, so editing, saving, and restoring are disabled
  • The left column can be collapsed with its collapse button, and dragging the line between columns resizes widths

AI call history · Token budget

Shows the most recent 20 AI calls (bundle, episode, input/output tokens, latency, success/failure) and today's token usage. The progress bar is the published-episode ratio.
manual.tab3:
7. Tab 4 — Author Review

Enter an episode number and press Load to show the manuscript and consistency analysis. The manuscript on this screen is read-only; revise only on the Writing screen. The right side has tabs in the order ① setting extraction → ② consistency check.

Manuscript body

  • Version picker: each rewrite stacks v1, v2, …. Past versions stay readable
  • Compare with previous version: checking it marks word-level differences (red strikethrough for deletions / green for additions)
  • One episode's manuscript is about 5,000–7,000 characters by default (changeable per novel in the novel info editor)

① Extraction tab — Setting memory

  1. Pressing Run setting extraction extracts setting change proposals from the current manuscript and shows them below the button as temporary proposals (with supporting quotes). Relative expressions like "today" or "here" are stored converted into the manuscript's dates, places, and names, so they stay understandable later without re-reading the manuscript.
  2. To start over from scratch, press Reset settings. After confirmation it clears this episode's saved settings, temporary proposals, aliases (confirmed and candidate), extraction history, and issues. To fix only the temporary proposals, use Revision request below (saved settings are kept).
  3. If the extraction results need fixes, write them in the Revision request box and press Request to extract again.
  4. When the ② consistency check finds nothing wrong, press Save settings to store them as the official memory. Saved content is immediately visible on the Settings screen, and once the manuscript changes it is marked stale so re-extraction and re-saving are needed.
  5. Alias/spelling candidates appear only when facts about a name exist but whose they are is unclear; pick the setting to link and press Link to apply it first at save time (ahead of the model's new-character judgment). Names without facts never list, and removing entries or events in the temporary proposals above removes their candidates together. Settings are created only when facts exist — a name alone never registers one.

② Consistency tab — Consistency analysis helper

Pressing Run full analysis compares the current manuscript against the confirmed memory (settings) of earlier episodes, finds consistency errors, and registers them in the same tab's issue list. Suspected aliases and same-name characters are registered as issue entries too. Ask anything else in the question box. Newly found errors from the chat are also registered in the list automatically.

② Consistency tab — Consistency issue list

  • Severity: Critical (worldview/core setting collapse) · Major (character/event contradiction) · Minor (spelling/awkwardness)
  • Each entry shows manuscript quotes together with the supporting episodes and settings
  • Entries fixed on the Writing screen are marked Resolved, and entries you choose not to fix are marked Won't fix
  • Request publishing is blocked while open issues remain
  • To analyze again, clear issues and analysis records with Reset consistency check. Resetting settings clears issues together
  • To fix contradictions in bulk, check open issues and press AI-fix selected contradictions and go to Writing. The AI saves a new version, switches back to Writing, and moves to the Writing screen. Verify with version comparison on the Writing screen

Back to writing

When fixes are needed, press Back to writing at the top. It switches straight back to Writing and moves to the Writing screen with that episode selected. Revise and request review again.

Request publishing

When the manuscript is satisfying and no issues are open, press Request publishing at the top right. The manuscript is confirmed and cannot be undone. It can only be pressed in the In Review state, and it is blocked when there is neither saved memory nor a fresh extraction for the current manuscript. With only an unsaved fresh extraction, it is confirmed automatically at publish time.
manual.tab4:
9. Tab 6 — Settings

Look up settings such as characters and places. Only confirmed changes show; unconfirmed proposals are excluded.

  • Search: finds the input wherever it appears — name, ID, attribute content, supporting sentences, time, or relations. When matched outside name/ID, the match with surrounding context shows below the name. Clicking shows details and history on the right
  • As-of episode: leaving it empty covers everything, while entering a number covers settings only up to that episode (list, state, history, and relations all use the same cutoff). Example: entering 6 shows the setting values at the end of EP 6 and only the relations valid then
  • Attribute history timeline: shows when and with which supporting sentence each change happened, in time order
manual.tab4b:
8. Tab 5 — Publishing

Manage the novel info and per-episode final editions to put on platforms. The 1 · Novel info tab covers the novel and cover, and the 2 · Publishing episodes tab covers per-episode editions.

  • Novel publishing info: the current novel title and account pen name are prefilled in the published novel title and author pen name. Edits auto-save when leaving the input.
  • Publishing platform: a per-novel record-only selection (default Munpia, auto-saves on change). The author uploads to the platform directly.
  • Generate AI blurb: composes a blurb of up to 500 characters from the logline, synopsis, and episode outlines, fills the input, and auto-saves. It does nothing without source material.
  • Cover image: jpg/png, up to 5MB. Preview, download, and deletion are available after registering.
  • Episode cards: picking a publishing episode opens its details on the right. Episodes done registering carry a registered-on-platform date badge.
  • Platform registration record: for episodes actually posted on a platform, record the registration date (today by default, editable) and a memo in the details. The platform at record time is stored together. Editing and deletion are possible and do not affect the publishing state.
  • Approved text view: the details show the publish-approved text read-only and can be read fullscreen.

manual.trouble:
12. Troubleshooting

SymptomWhat to check
Server does not bootCheck whether MODEL_API_KEY in .env is empty
Red error box on screenCheck the API path and status code in the box message. If transient, refresh and retry
Needs attention markCheck the reason in the Writing screen details (generation failure / budget exhausted)
Publish request is blockedMark open consistency issues as resolved or won't-fix
Token budget exceededCheck the top token chip. The daily budget is counted on a midnight (UTC) basis
AI answer never finishesLarger chat scope and total episodes take longer. Check the terminal for errors

The Traceback printed in the server terminal is the most accurate clue. Include it when asking for help.
